source: Public-domain melodies for the vocal Roadmap's songs, written for a high voice in comfortable keys (tinyNotation: c = C4, c' = C5; b- = B flat); a low voice sings them an octave down. Sung on 'la' or in sol-fa. Filed under List A (lively), B (lyrical) and C (folk).
